risks.proof: Close-up photos of both tyres (tread + sidewalls) and a photo showing tyre brand/model if any.
risks.if_unproven: Price as tyres needing replacement soon.

risks.risk: Gears may skip or shift poorly (derailleur adjustment, bent hanger, worn cassette/chain).
risks.proof: Video shifting through all gears while pedaling + close-up of derailleur and chain condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as gears not guaranteed (worst case: needs adjustment/parts).

Close-up photos of tyre tread and sidewalls on both wheels.
Photos of the folding hinge and frame joints (both sides) and any serial/label on the frame.
A receipt or any proof of purchase date (or serial/label that can be traced).
